description: Exact lookup of a recording by its ISRC (International Standard Recording Code, e.g. GBDUW0000053). Returns the track's full metadata, including BPM and musical key. Tempo and key: bpm (full tempo, e.g. 123) and musical key in three notations: key_alphanumeric (e.g. '10B'), key_musical (e.g. 'D', 'F#m') and key_open (Open Key, e.g. '3d'), plus keys[] with one entry per source. All null (keys empty) when the track has not been analysed.
name: lookup_isrc
title: Look up a track by ISRC
